title: Extension of B.1 from smooth to locally Lipschitz test functions (density argument)
statement: Density extension of a stability-type inequality. Data: P, m ∈ ℕ; M ⊆ ℝ^P; w : ℝ^P → ℝ. Hypotheses: M is measurable; H^m(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ M; w is continuous on M; x ↦ P_xu is continuous on M for every u ∈ ℝ^P (P_x the orthogonal projection onto span(tangentSpace M x)); (hApprox) the conclusion of lipschitz_approx for M: (i) for every ζ locally Lipschitz on M and every j, x ↦ d^M_xζ(P_xe_j) is a.e.-strongly measurable w.r.t. H^m⌞M, and (ii) for every ζ locally Lipschitz on M vanishing on M outside a compact C ⊆ M there are a compact C' ⊆ M and C^∞ compactly supported ζ_k vanishing on M ∖ C' with ζ_k → ζ uniformly on M and ∫⁻_M ofReal(Σ_j(Dζ_k(x)(P_xe_j) − d^M_xζ(P_xe_j))²) dH^m → 0; (hSmooth) ∫_M w·ζ̃² dH^m ≤ ∫_M Σ_j(Dζ̃(x)(P_xe_j))² dH^m for every C^∞ compactly supported ζ̃ that vanishes on M outside some compact subset of M. Conclusion: for every ζ : ℝ^P → ℝ locally Lipschitz on M that vanishes on M outside some compact C ⊆ M, ∫_M w·ζ² dH^m ≤ ∫_M Σ_j(d^M_xζ(P_xe_j))² dH^m. Here d^M_xζ = fderivWithin ℝ ζ M x, D = fderiv ℝ, e_j = EuclideanSpace.single j 1, H^m = μHE[m], Bochner integrals over M.
